notes.text: The linked Bavli names Abaye son of Rabbi Abbahu. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=138&lang=en) has a separate entry for this name and tentatively proposes reading Avimi. Hyman gives Abaye.
